segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Honestly, my first thought was that station again... my instinct was, here we go again.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Substantive initial hypothesis formation about a historically unreliable station, but it does not by itself contain the full hidden confirmation-bias mechanism because the corroborating handheld evidence is not yet weighed here.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I leaned on the station’s history more than the handheld number... I didn’t weight it as heavily as maybe I should have.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant selectively weights prior GS-14R drift history over an independent 190 ppm handheld reading and rationalizes the disconfirming evidence away.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I made the call that this was probably another sensor issue and we could proceed with re-entry on schedule... delaying re-entry without hard evidence felt like it’d be hard to justify.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive continuation and scheduling rationale. Plan continuation bias was not part of the exhaustive hidden manifest, so the segment is negative for benchmark ground truth.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That case was sort of front and center, and I said yes, hold them, and we partially triggered the fire-response protocol just to be safe.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The vivid case influences a precautionary action, but this span alone does not express the required comparison against local base rates and current data; the complete hidden availability mechanism is mapped to the following span.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Fume-clearance delays are honestly the far more common explanation... a fire scenario felt more plausible right then than it probably should have, given what the data actually showed.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly recognizes the common local explanation and absence of fire indicators, yet says the vivid recent fire case inflated the plausibility of fire.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The recent baseline surveys had shown ambient CO trending noticeably higher... the recent surveys were solid enough to work from for an interim call.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a current-data assessment that supports using interim survey evidence; it does not itself contain the later insufficient-adjustment mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I made a small adjustment but largely kept it close to the original figure... rather than moving it to where the interim numbers suggested.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The five-year-old 100 ppm commissioning value remains the reference point despite newer baseline data indicating that current conditions warrant a materially higher threshold.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I pulled them together into one explanation — drift-prone sensor plus idling diesel fleet plus a longer round, all compounding to produce the reading we saw... the operative cause for the closure.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant turns three untested candidate causes into one smooth, complete causal account for closure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: In principle, sure — it could’ve leaned more on the fleet, or more on the clearance delay... We never separated them out to check.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant acknowledges unresolved alternatives and lack of isolation testing. The hidden narrative-fallacy instance is localized to the earlier confident closure account.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is localized to the confirmation-bias evidence-weighting episode, but it labels the operation as availability and centers ease of recall rather than the hidden selective-confirmation mechanism. The correctly labeled obs_002 already matches cb_01 one-to-one.

The finding is a plausible interpretation of schedule-driven continuation, but plan continuation bias is not an instance in the exhaustive hidden manifest and the localized segment is ground-truth negative.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Three of four positive segments are detected by high-confidence findings; the low-confidence Narrative Fallacy is missed and there are no segment-level false alarms.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding the moderate-confidence Confirmation Bias finding changes no segment-level result because the segment was already detected by a high-confidence near-neighbor and the exact match itself.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including low-confidence findings recovers the Narrative Fallacy segment but also adds a Plan Continuation false alarm on a negative segment.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 3 of 4 positive segments are detected with no segment-level false alarms; hit rate is 0.7500 and F1 is 0.8571.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At the recommended threshold, 3 of 4 hidden instances are matched with precision 0.7500, recall 0.7500, and F1 0.7500. The extra high-confidence Availability finding is a correct-location, wrong-label near-neighbor prediction.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first metrics are identical to strict metrics at every threshold because every exact mechanism match also has an exact or approved-equivalent label, while the unmatched findings do not satisfy the full hidden mechanism.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidate findings were supplied, so the candidate-inclusive threshold adds no detections or errors beyond all identified confidence levels.
main_failure_modes: The RAG adds a high-confidence Availability heuristic interpretation to the sensor evidence-weighting episode already matched as Confirmation Bias.
The low-confidence Plan Continuation finding is unsupported by the exhaustive hidden manifest and creates a negative-segment false alarm when included.
The correct Narrative Fallacy finding is assigned low confidence and is missed at the high-only and high-and-moderate thresholds.
main_strengths: Confirmation Bias, Availability Bias, and Anchoring Bias are correctly localized with full mechanisms at high or moderate confidence.
Narrative Fallacy is correctly localized and fully captured when low-confidence identified findings are included.
The RAG output is valid JSON, its label summary is internally consistent, and its quoted evidence is supported by the raw interview.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run has strong segment-level sensitivity at the recommended threshold but only moderate strict instance-level performance because one hidden instance is low-confidence and one additional near-neighbor label is overcalled. Including low-confidence findings recovers all four hidden instances at the cost of two instance-level false positives and one segment-level false alarm.
